body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note: We are buying Goodman for its ability to execute, not for its book value. It owns more powered, correctly zoned land than any other listed property group we can buy. The next leg of returns depends on turning that land into leased data centres, including a large Australian rollout and we are getting that growth optionality at a mutliple not seen outside of exogenous shocks in recent years.
